pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit a highly irregular, stellate morphology with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Individual dark regions resemble starburst patterns with numerous radiating projections into the negative space. Patch size is largest on the upper flank and decreases in spatial area toward the hindquarters and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored corridors form a continuous topological graph with frequent tri-nodal and quadri-nodal junctions. The pixel thickness of these pathways is substantial and relatively uniform across the mid-flank, creating a distinct grid-like separation between the jagged patches.
